name: implement an integer mathematical function as a finite logic-gate network
definition: Design a gate network that, from the given 32-bit binary input representation, computes integer sqrt then the Fibonacci value reduced mod 2^32.
failure_mode: Incorrect arithmetic → wrong output for individual test values.

name: implement an O(n) particle physics simulation (serial + OpenMP) with genuine motion
definition: Serial spatial-binned O(n) particle update plus an OpenMP variant; particles genuinely move and match the serial run.
failure_mode: an unthreaded or MPI-orphan openmp binary missing required outputs fails inspection/runs

name: inject an init script that enables serial login under an authenticated names
definition: Author an init routine that mounts the pseudo-fs, registers a getty on the serial console, and sets up an unauthenticated user so a login prompt appears.
failure_mode: No login prompt, root rejected, or getty not started on the serial tty.

name: invoke the cipher on chosen plaintext within a strict time budget
definition: Query the cipher many times under random inputs with bounded complexity so the result is found quickly.
failure_mode: Over-budget or unoptimized search never converges in time.
